question: A user has decided they no longer want Claude to be able to reach a connected service. What should they do first?
options: A) Change the password on the service, which removes it from the connector list automatically.
B) Disconnect the service in the connector settings so that Claude can no longer reach it.
C) Delete the projects that used the service so that the connection has nothing left to read.
D) Ask Claude in each new chat to avoid using that service when it is answering questions.
correct_answers: B) Disconnect the service in the connector settings so that Claude can no longer reach it.
explanations: A password change is not how a connection is managed, and it disrupts other tools too.
Correct. Removing the connection is the direct control, and it takes effect for every conversation.
The connection remains live and reachable from any new conversation.
A per-chat request depends on being remembered every time and leaves the access in place.
